subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin expose both `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` as agent message actions, and should both remain behind the existing `channelInfo` capability gate?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new public agent-tool contract with Slack scope, discovery, and configuration implications; source evidence supports the plugin boundary but cannot choose the permanent capability and configuration policy.

options.title: Approve bounded Slack parity
options.body: Add both actions in `extensions/slack` behind the existing `channelInfo` capability, with cursor pagination, scope-aware errors, docs, and focused action/runtime tests.

options.title: Keep current targeted lookup only
options.body: Retain current Slack target-name and authorization lookup behavior without exposing general channel discovery to agents.

options.title: Split discovery policy first
options.body: Decide whether channel listing needs a distinct opt-in setting before accepting any new configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Slack parity
recommendation.body: Add both actions in `extensions/slack` behind the existing `channelInfo` capability, with cursor pagination, scope-aware errors, docs, and focused action/runtime tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the Slack action surfaces and documentation affected by the contract decision.
